noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

retryable.description: Retry action if failure is a retryable c3 exception such as VersionConflict.

class.description:
The Java class name of the native field type, parameter or return value (as marked with the "native" value type).

```type
listToArray: function(list: @java(class="java.util.List<String>") native): [string]
```

sourceVersion.description:
Specific version of the language required for the source code. The supported versions vary by language so for
languages that support multiple versions, this field is overridden with an enumeration. If unspecified, it is
assumed that the source code corresponds to a "base" version which is upward compatible.

boxed.description:
If `true` then Java Code gen will not use native Java values, e.g. for `lambda` but instead will generate signature
boxed instance type; i.e. `Lambda`

returnWildcardVarBindings.description:
If set Java code-gen will use wildcard for return class var bindings. I.e. without it:
```
Array<Obj> singletonArray()
```
with `@java(returnWildcardVarBindings=true)`
```
Array<? extends Obj> singletonArray()
```

runtimeClassName.description:
Name of the underlying java class. Useful for creating class instances using `Class.forName`. This is different from
canonical name for arrays and inner classes. In java, <object>.getClass.getName() returns class name.
Example: int[] - "[I", List - "java.util.List" , String[] - "[Ljava.lang.String"

runtimeFieldMapper.description: {@link JavaToC3FieldMapper} type used to get/set values to/from the java object.

constructorParamPos.description:
Maps a c3 field to a constructor parameter position. The field value is comma separated with the first value
representing the constructor index and the second value representing the parameter index.
```
class A { A(int f1, String f2); A(String f2); }
```
The above class will generate c3 fields
```
@java(constructorParamPos=["0,0","0,1"])
f1: int
@java(constructorParamPos=["1,0"])
f2: string
```

codeGenSetCached.description: Indicated that build time Java code-gen should auto generate `setCached<method>`

codeGenImplBase.description: Indicated that build time Java code-gen should generate _ImplBase instead of _Impl
